items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Zutty Singleton is in this too.

ctx.x: That was 1952; Duke and Basie were the only bands over you, I think. Here's one where you scored on a Pacific coast tour. This was October 1952 in the Courier, here you are along with Hamp and all the big names. Zutty Singleton is in this too.
These will be priceless, send these to Rutgers when you send him the tape.
